evidence.note: mixed-sign mean shift rules out fixed gamma/brightness; low clipping (2.1% pair0) rules out LUT scale variant which produced 16% extremes; logistic stretch maps per-channel means toward 0.5

analysis.rationale: Two deterministic steps on all 3 supports. JPEG confirmed by block_boundary > 1.1 on every support (0% FP signal) and dct_zero_ratio up to 0.93; unique_G=256 excludes quantization. Global confirmed as contrast_strengthen_stretch (not scale/gamma/brightness): variance_ratio ~2.0-2.5 with minimal clipping (2.1% pair0) and mixed-sign mean shifts across supports. Order stretch->JPEG beats JPEG->stretch (unique-value preservation argument). Severity scans show sharp peaks: stretch c=8 (sev4) and JPEG q5 (sev5). Cross-support: pair0 31.07 dB / pair1 28.27 dB / pair2 26.13 dB, all CI 10/10 with content-independent metric diffs <=3%. Verdict kept UNCERTAIN because pair-level PSNR is 26-31 dB (<40 threshold for LIKELY); residual attributed to tone-curve/JPEG quantization sensitivity, no better combination found in 17 candidate tests.
